A '''XJ9 Hypercharger''' was a [[weapon]] linkage mechanism used in large [[Starship/Legends|starship]] grade weaponry found in [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] starships.

==Behind the scenes==
XJ9 Hyperchargers are smuggler contraband in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Players of the smuggler profession can find them on slain enemies and either sell them or use them to get access to Contraband Smuggling missions.
